latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(video-player): Fix is playing property not updating by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12669
* fix(card-group): fix gray space bellow cards on mobile by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12667
* feat(lightbox): add fallback for cards with no title by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12672
* feat(masthead-footer): update nav data to the latest by @bruno-amorim in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12674
* feat(footer): new attr hide-cookie-preferences by @bruno-amorim in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12685
* fix(link-list-section): hide heading when empty by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12686
* fix(link-list-section): fix hide title slot when empty by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12691
* fix(carousel): correct display for nav element bug on safari by @bruno-amorim in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12692
* fix(card-group-item): fix grey spaces below cards by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12693
* ADCMS-12440: card-in-card video-thumbnail fix by @Valentin-Sorin-Nicolae in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12696
* fix(card-group-item): fix space missing on logo type by @marcelojcs in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12697
* fix(masthead-l1): ensure correct nav item highlights by @EnMod in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12701
* ADCMS-12677: image zoom-hover by @Valentin-Sorin-Nicolae in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12706

## New Contributors
* @EnMod made their first contribution in https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/pull/12701

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/compare/v2.60.3...v2.63.0

detail.readme:
Carbon for IBM.com

> This library is an extension of the Carbon IBM Design System. It contains > unique components shared between the IBM.com user journeys to unify its look > and feel.

## Getting started If you're just getting started, check out [`web components`](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/packages/web-components)! If you're trying to find something specific, here's a full list of packages that we support! | Package name | Description | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | | [`@carbon/ibmdotcom-web-components`](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/packages/web-components) | IBM.com web components and its React Wrappers | | [`@carbon/ibmdotcom-services`](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/packages/services) | IBM.com ES6 Service classes | | [`@carbon/ibmdotcom-styles`](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/packages/styles) | Framework agnostic styles package for IBM.com components | | [`@carbon/ibmdotcom-utilities`](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/packages/utilities) | IBM.com ES6 Utility classes | If you are building pages for IBM.com, [see what is needed on the page](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/docs/building-for-ibm-dotcom.md). ## Storybook demos - `@carbon/ibmdotcom-web-components`: https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/next/web-components ## Documentation - See our documentation site [here](http://www.ibm.com/standards/carbon) for full how-to docs and guidelines - [Contributing](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for making contributions to this repo. ## 🙌 Contributing We're always looking for contributors to help us fix bugs, build new features, or help us improve the project documentation. If you're interested, definitely check out our guides: - [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [Developer Guide](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/docs/developing.md) - [Contributing to the Web Components package](https://carbon-design-system.github.io/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/next/web-components/?path=/story/overview-contributing-to-the-web-components-package--page) - [Contributing to the React package](https://www.ibm.com/standards/carbon/react/?path=/story/overview-contributing-to-the-react-package--page) ## 📝 License Licensed under the [Apache 2.0 License](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-for-ibm-dotcom/blob/main/LICENSE).
